title: Pyrazolone-nicotinic acid derivative (4Z)-4-(2-hydroxybenzylidine)-5-methyl-2-(pyridine-3-ylcarbonyl)-2, 4-dihydro-3H-pyrazole-3-one (IIc) as multitarget inhibitor of neurodegeneration and behavioural impairment in Dementia.
authors: Kanwal, Madiha; Sarwar, Sadia; Nadeem, Humaira; Alghamdi, Suad A; Alamro, Abir Abdullah; Malik, Sumra; Maqsood, Saima; Alghamdi, Amani A; Tariq, Muhammad Junaid; Malik, Imran; Khan, Arif Ullah; Muskan, Aleena
journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吡唑啉酮-烟酸衍生物对东莨菪碱诱导痴呆小鼠的神经保护作用，涉及行为学、酶活和炎症因子检测，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: The study was aimed at the synthesis and pharmacological investigation of (4Z)-4-(2-hydroxybenzylidine)-5-methyl-2-(pyridine-3-ylcarbonyl)-2, 4-dihydro-3H-pyrazole-3-one (IIc) in mice model of scopolamine-induced neurodegeneration and cognition impairment. METHODS: The behavioural studies included Y-Maze Test, Water Morris Test, and Novel Object Recognition Test in Albino mice (20-25 g). Scopalamine was used as an inducing agent. The acetylcholinesterase (AChE) inhibitory assay was used to assess the role of the test compounds in vitro. The Crystal Violet Staining (Nissl staining) was used to assess the neuroprotective and antiapoptotic effect through quantifying the number of neurons and viability. The expression of the anti-inflammatory enzyme cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), cytokine tumour necrotic factor (TNF-alpha), key transcription factor producing pro-inflammatory signals nuclear factor kappa B (P-NFkB), and apoptosis marker p-JNK was validated through enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and immunohistochemical (IHC) analysis. The tested compound reverted cognitive and behavioural impairment through inhibiting scopolamine-induced inflammation and oxidative stress. KEY FINDINGS: We found that the compound IIc improved the short-term memory and learning behaviour of the experimental animals. Further investigation into molecular mechanisms showed that this effect was the manifestation of immunomodulatory, antioxidant, and consequently, of downsizing of inflammatory cytokines. These results were further validated through docking analysis. CONCLUSION: Finally, we conclude that the pyrazolone-nicotinic acid derivative IIc reversed the scopolamine-induced cognitive and behavioural deficits, attributed to acetylcholinesterase inhibition, neuronal recovery, antioxidant potential, and through downregulating the neuroinflammatory mediators p-NF-kB, cytokine TNF-alpha, and anti-inflammatory enzyme COX-2.
abstract_zh: 目的：本研究旨在合成(4Z)-4-(2-羟基亚苄基)-5-甲基-2-(吡啶-3-基羰基)-2,4-二氢-3H-吡唑-3-酮（IIc），并在东莨菪碱诱导的神经退行性变和认知障碍小鼠模型中对其进行药理学研究。方法：行为学研究包括Y迷宫测试、水莫里斯测试和新物体识别测试，使用白化小鼠（20-25克）。东莨菪碱作为诱导剂。采用乙酰胆碱酯酶（AChE）抑制试验评估测试化合物在体外的角色。使用结晶紫染色（尼氏染色）通过量化神经元数量和活力来评估神经保护和抗凋亡效应。通过酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）和免疫组织化学（IHC）分析验证了抗炎酶环氧化酶-2（COX-2）、细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子（TNF-alpha）、产生促炎信号的关键转录因子核因子κB（P-NFkB）以及凋亡标志物p-JNK的表达。测试化合物通过抑制东莨菪碱诱导的炎症和氧化应激，逆转了认知和行为障碍。主要发现：我们发现化合物IIc改善了实验动物的短期记忆和学习行为。对分子机制的进一步研究表明，这种效应是免疫调节、抗氧化以及随之而来的炎症细胞因子减少的表现。这些结果通过对接分析进一步验证。结论：最后，我们得出结论，吡唑啉酮-烟酸衍生物IIc逆转了东莨菪碱诱导的认知和行为缺陷，这归因于乙酰胆碱酯酶抑制、神经元恢复、抗氧化潜力，以及通过下调神经炎症介质p-NF-kB、细胞因子TNF-alpha和抗炎酶COX-2。
